what: Clicking a same-site link raises a contrasting curtain from the bottom of the screen in .6s power3.out to cover it (the inner panel comes down from the top at the same time and settles in place), and from .3s before it ends, five vertical strips above the logo at the curtain’s center grow from the top at 60ms offsets and shrink, repeating (1.08s loop, cubic-bezier(.25,1,.5,1) coming in · (.5,0,.75,0) going out). On the arriving page the strips keep cycling under the covering curtain, and once .4s has passed since it was covered and the page has fully arrived, the strips fold in place at 30ms offsets in .25s cubic-bezier(.33,1,.68,1), the logo fades out in .3s power2.out, and then the curtain slides up in .6s power3.out — a black-curtain transition where the logo blinks while waiting for the next page

options.dur: Duration for the curtain to rise and drop away (s), default .6
options.hold: Minimum time in seconds to stay after being covered, default .4 — 0 if switching often like an app
options.[data-fx-part=mark]: Logo (svg·img) at the center of the curtain — pieces cover and uncover it
options.--fx-cover · --fx-mark · --fx-size · --f: Mask color · logo color · logo box size (default 100px) · one turn of a piece (1.08s) · delay between pieces (60ms)
options.[data-no-wipe]: Links in here go through without a transition

note: The original is an SPA, so it receives and swaps in the next screen while the curtain stays covering. Here, after covering we move the address, and the arriving page starts from the covered curtain and walks through the same sequence

from.where: All pages .iw-veil — original TransitionLink: curtain y .6 power3.out, five iw-loader-slice pieces 1.08s (60ms offset), when finished they fold in .25s cubic-bezier(.33,1,.68,1) with 30ms offset, then after .3 power2.out y −100% .6 power3.out, minimum 400ms
